o.text: Ultimately from Proto-Turkic *tāg-. Cognate with Turkish dağılmak.
Borrowed from Arabic عُمُومِيّ (ʕumūmiyy). By surface analysis, ümum + -i.
Borrowed from Arabic خَانَقَاه (ḵānaqāh), from Classical Persian خَانَگَاه (xānagāh), from خَانَه (xāna, “house”) + ـگَاه (-gāh).
